text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of training, but Haru 
Urara seems down about something.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... That cloud looks like Trainer, 
doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's strange lately. My body feels 
so heavy, like lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her future success, it 
seems we'll need to review her race 
schedule...
